prose.text: The chunk's own guard, pins and two live entries come first, then the standard gate set in test-plan §3 order (`capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest, the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen as the last cargo-adjacent step, the base-identity bindings close, since the chunk adds no procedure), then the local pre-push check, then the operator pass.

**The engine cycle** is the runtime gate of this chunk. It starts its own engine and ends it, on ports 24317 and 24318 and a fresh data dir under `target/engine-cycle/`; it never binds 4317 or 4318. The entry first builds the exit-witness library and names it in the verb's environment, so the run shows `boot engine` leaving it unloaded.

**The window smoke** is listed because the window path of `boot` and `status` changes (the program is now asked). It is the series of two boots on this host in its recorded form: each under its own virtual display, the receivers on 14317 and 14318, `WAYLAND_DISPLAY` unset, a fresh data dir under `target/boot-smoke/`.

Absences, each with its reason: - No product boot-path file is touched (`main.rs`, `engine_boot.rs`, `console.rs`, `observability.rs`), so no   boot-smoke gate is owed for the product; the two live entries above are the harness's own. - No webview gate and no headful self-verify: no `pulse-app/ui/**` path is touched. The `a11y` job's verdict   is read from the operator pass's run. - No local `cargo audit` or `cargo deny` entry: no dependency is added and the scope guard holds `Cargo.lock`   unchanged; the `supply-chain` job reads both on the operator pass's run. - No one-shot mutating control: each arm's red reading is a committed pin on a constructed log. - No retry anywhere. A cycle that reads red, or a boot that ended by itself, stops the pass and goes to the   operator.

**The operator pass, in this order.** The hygiene entry; the pre-CI commit; the local pre-push check again; the merge-base probe; the build-branch push; the CI read of the pushed tip, asserted green; the run's `logs-boot-Linux` artifact, with the series verdict, the smoke's settle verdict, every kept witness file read whole and the window's boot record; the run's `logs-engine-Linux` artifact, graded again by `check:engine-log` on this host. A line of a witness file holding anything beyond its shape stops the pass. A red is fixed by a further commit on top and read again.
